structure_source: Tian 2025 — 2-chloro-5-nitropyrimidine with an X-ray-confirmed Cys113 adduct; class recorded from the anchor in pin1_reference_binders_2.csv
notes: 2-chloro-5-nitropyrimidin-4-yl: attachment at C4, chlorine retained at C2 (the SNAr leaving group), nitro at C5 activating the ring. An earlier version of this row omitted the chlorine entirely and the warhead-validity gate correctly killed all 198 products. Aryl chloride displaced by SNAr, NOT a CH2-Cl. Mechanistically distinct from chloroacetamide and was initially misassigned to it, which produced a dock with no matching reactive atom. The SMARTS requires a ring nitrogen adjacent to the C-Cl so plain chlorobenzenes do not match.

structure_source: Decoy-side class test added 2026-07-30. The narrow snar_chloroazine attachment SMARTS hard-codes a pyrimidine bearing BOTH an amine and a nitro -- it describes Tian 6a specifically, so all 175 other chloroazines in the ChEMBL pool failed the adduct check and the class had 3 decoys against a gate minimum of 10.
notes: SEPARATE FROM snar_chloroazine ON PURPOSE, following the precedent set for naphthoquinone: the library's classes are T_4's ENUMERATION units, while a decoy has to match the active's CHEMISTRY. Generalising the shared class instead would have made 30 of T_4's 198 snar products degenerate in their attachment site. Chlorine flanked by two ring nitrogens is SNAr-activated on the ring nitrogens alone; the nitro raises the rate, it does not create the mechanism.

display_name: Cinnamamide (aryl Michael acceptor, class test only)
structure_source: Decoy-side class test added 2026-07-30 for Ieda-2019-(S)-2 (PMID 30585173, ESI-MS-confirmed Cys113 adduct). The acrylamide class could not hold it: its group SMARTS [CH2]=[CH]C(=O)[NX3] demands an unsubstituted terminal alkene, and its adduct pattern [CH3][CH2][CX3](=O)[NX3] demands the saturated product end in a methyl. A cinnamamide gives ArCH2CH2C(=O)N and fails both.
notes: Aryl-conjugated Michael acceptor amide. A DISTINCT chemotype from plain acrylamide, not a relaxation of it: conjugation with the arene lowers the electrophilicity and the beta carbon is substituted, so decoys drawn from one are not property- or reactivity-matched to the other. Thiol adds at the beta carbon; the adduct is the SATURATED 3-thio-propanamide, with no re-aromatization available (D0030).
